title: Sunday · Dog Night, 2020
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · the aggregator
logline: Twenty-one years, the last public Dog Night. The sign with nearly every letter dark, the glow above the ridge the largest the strip has drawn, the pup at six, and no hand in the last tier — the man's hands in his pockets, the dog leaning on his shin instead.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the bowling sign over the alley with nearly every letter dark, and above the roofline the ridge's glow large and warm.

image.prompt: a neon bowling alley sign with nearly every letter dark above a night alley and a large warm glow over the ridge beyond the roofline, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Dark

panels.composition: Tier 2: the man and the pup walking the alley in rain, both smaller than the strip usually draws them.

image.prompt: a man and a small three-legged dog walking a rainy alley at night drawn small in the frame, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Walk

panels.composition: Tier 3: the dumpster, the man's hands in his pockets, the pup leaning against his shin.

image.prompt: a man with his hands in his coat pockets beside a dumpster in a rainy alley with a small three-legged dog leaning against his shin, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Shin

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; Sundays wet-on-wet; 2019: the Sunday drawn to a smaller grid
art.palette: ink and one tone; Sundays gray-green, fog, rust; 2020: ochre and slate arriving

notes: Twenty-one. The last public Dog Night. No hand; the lean.
